lines.say: Your best client hasn't texted in six weeks. So you lose your fucking mind.
You buy a monster truck. And a goat. For security.
You flatten the shop he's been going to instead. Every last chair.
He walks out going, damn, I just forgot. Forgot!
And you would've gotten away with it, if you'd just texted him at week three.
caps: You'd have gotten away with it

lines.say: MsgHealth spots who's gone quiet, and texts them for you. No truck needed.
